notes.title: Demo Update Notice
notes.content:
Hello everyone,
We've rolled out another game update with several fixes. Here's what's new:

● Increased starting capital for all difficulty levels
● Boosted movie revenue for better game balance
● Improved tutorial guidance
● Improved tooltip design for script/movie analysis
● Enhanced operational experience
● Optimized multilingual translations
● Fixed known issues

notes.title: 《Super Movie Tycoon》Demo Now Live!✨
notes.content:
《Super Movie Tycoon》Demo Now Live!
Hello everyone, thank you very much for your support. Now the Demo version is online. If you have any questions, you can leave us a message in the discussion area.

[b]Current Known Issues:[/b]
1.In-game bugs may occur
2.Occasional system errors
3.Localization inconsistencies

[b]Demo Content Highlights:[/b]
1.3 customizable construction zones
2.E-C grade movie scripting & filming
3.Third-party film distribution system
4.6 major film genres with themed sets
5.Curated decoration items
6.4 professions: Screenwriter, Researcher, Director, Actor


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45585404/c11be8cdb1e903dd6e236bcbfafc6e2f6d53bee2.jpg[/img]

We'll continue polishing the demo. Your feedback matters! Join the discussion on our official forums.

notes.title: "Super Movie Tycoon" Dev Progress & May Update Preview✨
notes.content:
Greetings, filmmakers! We're proud to launch the Steam store page for "Super Movie Tycoon"!

Current features include:
✔ Scriptwriting & film production toolkit
✔ Distribution network from agencies to self-release
✔ Staff development (writers, actors, directors, composers, artists, R&D, marketers, VFX)
✔ IP brokerage system
✔ Studio expansion builder
✔ Realtime film/studio leaderboards
✔ Dynamic competitor AI
✔ Talent acquisition market
✔ Banking & financial simulation
✔ 15 genres × 150 themes × 50+ locations
